description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_PercentEncoder, which handles percent-encoding operations such as encoding and normalizing URIs, including preserving certain characters and decoding percent-encoded sequences.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_PercentEncoder
classes.description: A class for encoding and normalizing percent-encoded URIs, with configurable preservation of characters.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the encoder with optional characters to preserve during encoding.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes a string by percent-encoding non-reserved characters, respecting the preserve list.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Decodes and normalizes percent-encoded strings, preserving certain characters based on the preserve list.
